# Hand-edited, and the only hand-edited file of the census. The code cannot
# regenerate these columns (the census note's revision (b)2 §7); the gate
# every proven multi-writer fact has at least one row here and that no row
# names a fact that is not one; scripts/ci/check-census-unknowns.ps1 refuses a
# row added against the merge base that names no owner or says "proposed".
# Keyed by fact; a coarse field is split into its parts, one row each
# class: OBS, ASYNC, DUR, LIFE, PROJ (ARCHITECTURE §4.2) and VIEW, HUB, RES (the
# census note §2). proposed_owner: the module the note proposes as sole writer

Linux census: App holds one NotificationDesk; Runtime::raise_attention submits, FolioApp drains failure; refusal stays latched until exit, desk drop cancels helper sends and DesktopRetire reaps them

T-PROGRAMS-REFRESH (2026-10-08): FolioApp levels the seats at the window directory's walk (window_news::seat_every_holder) and tells every seat when a program walk's answer moved something (adopt_program_walk, WindowSeats::tell_all); each window's turn in runtime::profiles takes only its own seat (take_program_news)

T-PROGRAMS-REFRESH (2026-10-08): set once at the launch when a launch tab's shell is in birth; the launch fills the BT_STARTUP line it measured (main.rs), and runtime::panes' birth landing records each born shell's source and clears it once both lines are said

T-SHELL-BIRTH-DEATH (2026-10-10): a hand-off, not a shared state: the birth road stores bt-pty's fallback record when it seats a shell, and runtime::panes takes it once, at the landing, because only the runtime knows the pane's seat that the diagnostics line names

T-SHELL-BIRTH-DEATH (2026-10-10): the field is Some exactly when pty is; the birth road sets it with the shell, and runtime::tabs clears it when the reaper retires a birth-death PTY and keeps the pane without one
